summary: Phase 4 (Dealer Distribution) fully verified backend + frontend end-to-end. Backend pytest 13/13 pass: setup pipeline (French dealer order EUR qty=3 serialised → assign 3 serials → release → pick all 3 → QC pass all 3 → package add-unit → seal → dispatch SHP-000001 in_transit) followed by Phase 4 endpoints — GET /shipments list; GET /shipments/{id} detail (with units, packages, receipt=null, docs=[]); POST /shipments/{id}/status (in_transit persisted, invalid status 400); PUT /shipments/{id}/customs (incoterm=DAP, hs_code, declared_value, currency=EUR persisted); POST /shipments/{id}/documents packing_list twice (rev1, rev2 confirmed), delivery_note (rev1), invalid doc_type→400; POST /shipments/{id}/receive with unknown serial → 409 error='serial_not_in_shipment'; then 2 confirmed + 1 damaged → receipt_status=discrepancy_reported, shipment_status=delivery_discrepancy, order status becomes partially_received; GET /dealer-inventory returns exactly the 2 confirmed serials (damaged one absent); POST /transfers with same source+dest→400; full lifecycle awaiting_approval → approved → in_transit → received; /summary returns all 5 counters and reflects the discrepancy + 2 dealer_held_units. UI E2E: logged in as owner@isodemo.com, opened /service-desk/inventory?s=shipments → SHP-000001 row visible; opened shipment detail (inv-shipment-detail) → all cards render (inv-ship-tracking, inv-ship-status, inv-ship-customs, inv-ship-documents, inv-ship-receipt, inv-receipt-done). Customs fields pre-populated (incoterm=DAP, hs_code=9506.91, declared_value=1500, currency=EUR); Save customs updates hs_code to 9506.91.90. Documents list shows 3 versioned rows (inv-doc-DEL-SHP-000001-R1, inv-doc-PAC-SHP-000001-R1, inv-doc-PAC-SHP-000001-R2); generating another delivery_note appended 4th doc (R2), and another packing_list produced 5th (R3) — no silent overwrite. Receipt-done section shows 'Discrepancy Reported · Confirmed: P4S…-0, P4S…-1 · Damaged: P4S…-2'. Dealer Inventory (inv-nav-dealer-inventory) lists exactly the 2 confirmed serials as Available (inv-dealer-holding-P4S…-0, inv-dealer-holding-P4S…-1) — damaged serial NOT shown. Transfer Orders (inv-nav-transfers): source/dest selects + submit render; created TRF-000002, then advanced Approve → Dispatch → Receive via inv-transfer-action-TRF-000002; final status 'Received' (green check). Regression: inv-nav-dispatch renders Dispatch Queue empty (as expected — only shipped order was delivered). All Phase 1–3 nav items still render (Warehouses, Distribution Orders, Sage Orders, Order Exceptions, Receiving, Picking, QC, Packing).
critical_code_review_comments: dealer_receive() upserts dealer_inventory_holdings using {**of, unit_id} match but $set includes 'id': _uid() — on repeat receives (idempotency) this will regenerate id and received_date every time. Consider $setOnInsert for id/received_date so the record identity is stable across re-confirmations.

generate_document uses count_documents+1 for revision — safe under single-writer, but two concurrent generate calls could produce identical revisions. Acceptable for current single-user ops; consider $inc on a counter for concurrency safety if this ever gets multi-user.

dealer_receive resolves serials via _normalise_serial(...) which strips non-alphanumerics upper. If a user pastes a serial with different whitespace/hyphens the code correctly resolves — but the receipt record then stores the DB's original serial_number (from confirmed u.get('serial_number')). Good, consistent with pick path.
transfer_action performs no state-machine guard — you can call /approve on an already-received transfer and it'll overwrite status back to 'approved'. Consider adding valid-from-state checks.
UI TransferOrders.step() catches any error with a generic notify.error('Failed') — losing the backend error detail. Would be nicer to surface the detail like other actions.
InvDealerDist.js is inside a monolithic file (~220 lines) but does 4 responsibilities. Fine for now; watch it grow.

SHIP_STATUSES on the FE dropdown doesn't include 'draft', 'awaiting_booking' — matches backend's non-user-driven states, but 'delivery_discrepancy' and 'returned' are shown even though ops probably shouldn't set those manually. Cosmetic.
seed_data_creation: Test warehouses P4 WHA <TAG> + P4 WHB <TAG>, order to 'TEST P4 FR Dealer <TAG>' (France/EUR, qty 3), SHP-000001 in delivery_discrepancy state with 3 versioned packing_list revisions + 2 delivery_note revisions, 2 dealer_inventory_holdings for confirmed serials, and TRF-000001 + TRF-000002 (both Received) all left in iso-demo-org. Acceptable per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 4 data-testids in InvDealerDist.js align with spec: inv-shipments, inv-shipment-row-<REF>, inv-shipment-detail, inv-shipment-back, inv-ship-tracking, inv-ship-status, inv-ship-customs, inv-customs-<field>, inv-customs-save, inv-ship-documents, inv-gen-doc-<type>, inv-doc-<REF>, inv-ship-receipt, inv-receipt-unit-<uid>, inv-receipt-confirm-<uid>, inv-receipt-damage-<uid>, inv-receipt-submit, inv-receipt-done, inv-dealer-inventory, inv-dealer-holding-<serial>, inv-transfers, inv-transfer-source/-dest/-submit, inv-transfer-row-<REF>, inv-transfer-action-<REF>. Note dealer inventory list has a small render race — always wait ~2s after navigating to inv-dealer-inventory before asserting rows (useEffect fetch); the empty-state check on first render may misfire otherwise.
